temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and says he is in trouble; he didn't want to worry Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him and feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his suspicion is confirmed; he learns Jonathan's hidden issue is that Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts that he could use support and resources and needs to find a way out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it; he is worried and wants to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he learns Jonathan is willing to accept his support and needs resources to escape the situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan needs his help, support, and resources to resolve the trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support and help Jonathan find resources or a way out.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure if the trouble is illegal; he may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but claims he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs support and resources, but does not yet know whether it involves criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he learns the trouble may involve criminal or wrong-people connections, though Jonathan denies personal illegal acts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or dangerous people, but Jonathan may not be personally guilty.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation indicates that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up. He tells Jonathan he has leads and will gather evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan may have gotten involved with wrong people or possible criminal activity, though Jonathan claims innocence; he intends to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his investigation shifts his belief from possible criminal involvement to Jonathan being an innocent victim of a frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed and is innocent; the real culprit is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather more evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian says he has found out who is behind the frame-up: someone both he and Jonathan know and trust. Jonathan reacts with disbelief; Christian resolves to confront the culprit and bring them to justice.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person and has been gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he identifies the real culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan, making the situation a personal betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes a trusted mutual acquaintance is responsible for framing Jonathan and has betrayed them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, while being careful because they may be dangerous.
